```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class UserForm extends Component
{
    // Public properties
    public $name = '';
    public $email = '';

    // Basic methods
    public function save()
    {
        // Logic to save the user data using Laravel's Auth facade
        Auth::user()->update([
            'name' => $this->name,
            'email' => $this->email
        ]);

        session()->flash('success', 'User information updated successfully.');
    }

    public function delete()
    {
        // Logic to delete the user data using Laravel's Auth facade
        if (Auth::check()) {
            Auth::user()->delete();
            session()->flash('success', 'User account deleted successfully.');
        } else {
            session()->flash('error', 'You do not have permission to delete this account.');
        }
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.user-form');
    }
}
```
